Where Punctual Pros Should Expand First

Expand first in the Mid-Atlantic counties next to the Central-PA core, not across the country. Chester County (PA), New Castle County (DE), Worcester County (MD) and the Jersey Shore counties already have named tuck-in targets. Why Start Close to Home

  • Phase 1 (months 0-12) fills in 248 core Central-PA ZIP codes and the 195 best nearby ZIP codes: 144 in PA and 51 in MD (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).
  • Phase 2 (months 9-24) repeats the Horvath deal in PA, NJ, MD, DE and southern NY. That area has 54 mapped Authority territories that Punctual Pros does not own (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).
  • In the case set, the best exits made their first add-ons early and close to home. They then added one every three to five months (value creation cases).

Next Actions

  1. Score every county in the national counties table on the Phase 1-2 criteria. Then publish a ranked Mid-Atlantic shortlist and a separate Phase 4 national list.
  2. Open discussions with the Ron Williams group for a combined West Chester and Delmarva deal.
  3. Get employee and revenue data for the top ten targets, which the screen could not supply.

# Where Punctual Pros Should Expand First

**Expand first in the Mid-Atlantic counties next to the Central-PA core, not across the country.** Chester County (PA), New Castle County (DE), Worcester County (MD) and the Jersey Shore counties already have named tuck-in targets. A true nationwide county ranking needs scoring that the context does not show.

## Why Start Close to Home

- Phase 1 (months 0-12) fills in 248 core Central-PA ZIP codes and the 195 best nearby ZIP codes: 144 in PA and 51 in MD (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).
- Phase 2 (months 9-24) repeats the Horvath deal in PA, NJ, MD, DE and southern NY. That area has 54 mapped Authority territories that Punctual Pros does not own (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).
- In the case set, the best exits made their first add-ons early and close to home. They then added one every three to five months (value creation cases).
- National scale comes only in Phase 4, inside the 1,066-outlet One Hour / Ben Franklin / Mister Sparky system (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).

## First-Wave Counties

| County | State | Anchor target | Fit score |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lancaster (home county, est.) | PA | Lancaster Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electrical, 5 miles from HQ | 84 |
| Chester | PA | Ron Williams group, West Chester tri-brand | 82 |
| Monmouth, Middlesex, Somerset, Union, Essex | NJ | C&C Air Conditioning, Heating, Plumbing & Electric | 82 |
| New Castle | DE | Calvert's One Hour / Ben Franklin, Wilmington | not shown |
| Worcester | MD | Ron Williams group, Delmarva | not shown |

All rows come from the Punctual Pros add-on targets screen. Treating Lancaster as the home county is an inference from the Running Pump Rd HQ location (est.).

- One owner runs both West Chester and Delmarva. A single deal could therefore open two counties (Punctual Pros add-on targets).
- Mechanicsburg (Zimmerman, score 80) and Pleasantville, NJ (PHE, score 80) are also top-five targets. The screen does not list their counties.

## What the Data Cannot Answer

- The national counties table exists, but its county-level fields and rankings are not in the context. A ranked list would need housing units, heating and cooling degree days, Redfin market data and Authority Brands counts for each county.
- Connecticut cannot be scored yet. Its climate, Redfin and Authority fields are null because of the planning-region mismatch (national counties table).
- The screen has no employee or revenue figures for targets because ZoomInfo enrichment was unavailable. Deal sizes are therefore unknown (Punctual Pros add-on targets).

## Next Actions

1. Score every county in the national counties table on the Phase 1-2 criteria. Then publish a ranked Mid-Atlantic shortlist and a separate Phase 4 national list.
2. Open discussions with the Ron Williams group for a combined West Chester and Delmarva deal.
3. Get employee and revenue data for the top ten targets, which the screen could not supply.
4. Map the 54 unowned Authority territories to counties. This will show where the 17 competing sponsors overlap with BSP's first-wave counties.
